question: Select the most appropriate antonym of the word: **Concomitant**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Separate**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Concomitant"** refers to something that naturally accompanies or follows something else, often in a simultaneous or related manner. (सहगामी)
 
 
• **Example:** The rise in unemployment was concomitant with the economic downturn.
 
 
• **"Separate"** means existing apart or distinct from something else, often implying division or independence. (अलग)
